svg.aria-label: WayClub. Guided demo with sample data. A workspace for student clubs to plan events, approve proposals and manage registrations, with PostgreSQL policies that keep each club’s data separate. Built with Next.js, NestJS and PostgreSQL. The screenshot shows a club workspace with events, proposals and committee members, using fictional data.
